key: Transfer Fcn Direct Form II Time Varying
title: Transfer Fcn Direct Form II Time Varying
text: Implement time varying Direct Form II realization of transfer function, 3 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Integer rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for fixed-point operations; {Initial condition} and {Saturate to max or min when overflows occur} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate to max or min when overflows occur
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on
